summary: GeoPark Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a strategic acquisition of the Bare Block in Venezuela's Orinoco Belt via a 25-year Production Participation Contract with PDVSA. Grupo Gilinski, who led the opportunity, financed the deal with GeoPark equity, expecting to become controlling shareholder. The issuance occurs at a premium, and a tender offer will provide liquidity to existing shareholders. No specific price per share or premium was disclosed. Asset attributes include 15.7 billion barrels OOIP, ~11,000 bopd current production, with potential to rise to 85,000-95,000 bopd. Watch for regulatory approvals and the tender offer terms.
